problem.text: The chat example previously left sampling options as a TODO and constructed jobs without an explicit sampler.

reasoning.text: The change constructs one ComboSampler from command-line arguments and reuses it for each response job, exposing existing sampling machinery rather than adding new filtering implementations.

impact.text: Defaults retain the previous preset's min-p threshold of 0.08 and temperature of 0.8, with temperature applied after filtering and penalties disabled. ComboSampler nevertheless requests token history because CustomSampler records history requirements before replacing neutral penalties with no-ops; Job consequently allocates a pinned history buffer.
The parser also removes --refresh_per_second/-rps. Whole-parent-tree search found its declaration but no consumers.

source_notes.text: The preceding ComboSampler entry identified its invalid min_p=0 default.
That constructor restriction remains unchanged. Chat avoids it with its 0.08 default, but explicitly requesting the newly advertised --min_p 0 still reaches the assertion.

Reviewed discussions concern “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate” (#7), “`cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B` generates incoherent output for bpw <= 2.5” (#15), and “Build Failure on Windows: CUDA 12.4 / PyTorch 2.7.0+cu126 / VS 2022” (#21). Their reported subjects are extension loading, quantization and compilation, respectively; none identifies this chat argument change.

limitations: No chat session, repository sampler, tensor operation or CUDA kernel was executed. The standard-library checks model scalar predicates, slicing and filter mathematics, not GPU behavior or output quality.

claims.text: Arguments flow through ComboSampler into repetition and presence/frequency penalties, optional early temperature, min-p, top-k, top-p, optional late temperature and categorical sampling. Job.receive_logits supplies logits and current token history to the sampler.

Repetition defaults to the neutral multiplier 1; presence and frequency default to zero. The single penalty_range option, default 1024, populates both sustain and decay: it means 1024 recent full-strength tokens plus an older 1024-token fading window, not merely a 1024-token total window.

Min-p retains probabilities at least max_probability × min_p. Top-k masks sorted entries after K; values below one select a no-op. Top-p defaults to the no-op value 1; its active implementation retains the first candidate and masks later candidates whose cumulative probability exceeds P.

--temperature_first changes which candidates survive probability-based filtering, whereas the default late temperature only reweights survivors. Temperature divides logits or raises probabilities to its reciprocal.
A scalar illustration with probabilities [0.6, 0.3, 0.1], temperature 0.5 and min-p 0.3 retained only candidate 0 with early temperature, versus candidates 0 and 1 with late temperature.

findings.description: The CLI parses top-k as a float, but the selected sampler uses it directly as a slice boundary.
findings.trigger: Run chat with an explicit --top_k value at least 1, such as --top_k 40.
findings.expected_behavior: Keep the requested integer number of leading candidates.
findings.actual_behavior: The parser produces 40.0, which ComboSampler passes unchanged to SS_TopK.run's slice. This is an invalid slice index. The default zero bypasses that step. Reach is established for the newly added chat call; parent-tree searches found only the ComboSampler definition/export and separate SS_TopK uses in presets and tests, not a universal failure of other samplers.

verification.description: Parsed 40 with the same argparse float conversion and attempted a list slice, obtaining TypeError.
verification.limits: Standard-library reproduction of the type mismatch, not execution of PyTorch slicing or chat.

findings.description: The advertised min-p disable value violates the existing step constructor.
findings.trigger: Run chat with --min_p 0 and assertions enabled.
findings.expected_behavior: Construct a sampler with min-p truncation disabled, as the new help text promises.
findings.actual_behavior: ComboSampler unconditionally constructs SS_MinP(0), whose assertion requires 0 < min_p <= 1. Construction fails before the chat loop. The chat default 0.08 avoids this inherited restriction.

verification.description: Traced the new chat call through ComboSampler to SS_MinP and searched the parent tree for ComboSampler callers.
verification.limits: No repository constructor executed; external callers are unexamined.

annotation.summary: Adds chat sampling arguments through ComboSampler, preserving default filtering while exposing invalid top-k typing and an unsupported min-p disable value.

argv:
import argparse
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--top_k',type=float,default=0)
k=p.parse_args(['--top_k','40']).top_k
try: [1,2,3][k:]
except TypeError as e: print(type(k).__name__,str(e))
print('min_p=0 passes constructor predicate:',0.0 < 0.0 <= 1.0)
a=[.6,.3,.1];t=.5;m=.3
for early in [True,False]:
 q=[v**(1/t) for v in a] if early else a
 print('early',early,'retained',[i for i,v in enumerate(q) if v>=max(q)*m])
